pages.text: We have filled the $(item)Combat Simulation$() with several monsters you've encountered in previous simulations.$(br2)So the following pages will only mention new monsters that you will need to learn to master how to fight.

pages.name: Endermen
pages.text: Tall ethereal beings of the void. Putting $(l:sim_4/helpful_stuff)Enderference$() parts in your weapons will stop them from warping.

pages.name: Witches
pages.text: Masters of Alchemy, and they're no friend of yours. Found on the large spawning platforms in the $(item)Combat Simulation$().
